subject.title: Add SQLite snapshot artifacts under backup

question: Should OpenClaw core ship `openclaw backup sqlite snapshot` now, or keep SQLite snapshot artifacts in the host/plugin pilot path until the RFC and stress evidence are accepted?
rationale: The PR body says the Scout/Lobster pilot should decide whether the long-term surface is core, host-owned plugin, or both, and the command snapshots sensitive global/per-agent state under a public backup CLI.

options.title: Repair and continue core review
options.body: Remove the two mechanical blockers, keep the core nested backup command, and have maintainers explicitly accept the security/product boundary before merge.

options.title: Pause for pilot and RFC
options.body: Keep the PR open as draft until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94967 and the external RFC/pilot data prove the core surface is worth shipping.

options.title: Move to host/plugin ownership
options.body: Close or narrow the core PR if maintainers decide the artifact lifecycle should remain in the host-owned plugin path for now.

recommendation.title: Repair and continue core review
recommendation.body: Remove the two mechanical blockers, keep the core nested backup command, and have maintainers explicitly accept the security/product boundary before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: galiniliev is the current assignee and already reviewed the snapshot correctness boundary on this PR.
